sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0344: part BR-310; plant TO2; customer CLM; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-5083-H111; status APPROVED 2025-06-11 (PPAP-2025-052)
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Approval is granted per part, per receiving plant and per customer, never per supplier.
A temporary deviation does not approve a new material source.

findings.why: The proposal is to run BR-310 for CLM at Plant 1 (TO1) with Meccanica C billet. The only approval for BR-310 is AP-0344, which covers plant TO2 only. The ASL is the complete list for TO1 and TO2 and for STL and CLM, so Meccanica C has no approval for BR-310 at TO1 for CLM. A temporary deviation cannot grant one, and the TO2 approval does not carry over to TO1.
